subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eed2abbfc4ec5520cbe1d5ba63d8d8907354be9a0df8534611c471abcda64faa.png]
solution:
When we compare both the figures we get,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e61c48022b80c097e270804a19ce5aa326300b4f8f8c5d9d021da97bc2f3ef0.png] 

**Method 1:** In an ideal dice sum of two opposite sides of the dice is 7.

So, opposite pairs could be: (1, 6), (2, 5), and (3, 4).

According, to this concept we can say that,** "6** is the number on the face opposite to the face showing 1".
